People solely suffering from mental illness are temporarily excluded from MAiD since March 9, 2023, until March 17, 2027. This is due to provinces and territories needing time to prepare guidelines for the implementation in their healthcare system.

Assisted Suicide.note:
The development of a legislation legalizing Assisted Dying is currently in progress.
Interestingly, the Northern Territories were the first region in Australia to legalize Assisted Dying in 1995. However, the legislation was overturned by the federal government in 1997, restricting the the legislative autority of the territories. With the Restoring Territory Rights Act (2022) the Northern Territory and the Australian Capital Territory regained their legislative powers, allowing to legalize Assisted Dying once again.
